parse.title: The Joust
parse.wikitext:
{{Event Header|Event-Joust.png}} {{E|The Joust}} is a shrine [[Event]] found in [[Act 2]]. This event can only be encountered with more than 50 [[Gold]]. ==Options== {{Frame|Murderer}} {{TS|gold||Bet 50 Gold}} - {{TS|positive||70%: win 100 Gold.}} {{Frame|Owner}} {{TS|gold||Bet 50 Gold}} - {{TS|positive||30%: win 250 Gold.}} There is no option to avoid betting. ==Dialogue==
As you make your way through the large buildings you come across a long narrow bridge and spot knights on either side, facing one another.
You approach...
{{TS||shake|"HALT!"}}
A knight forcefully gestures you to stop with its giant lance.


{{Frame|Continue}}
"Today is the day I must settle the score with the {{TS|negative||murderer}} of my beloved pet, {{TS|gold||Noodles.}} Until then, you may not pass.
Fellow witness, why don't you {{TS|blue||bet}} on who you think will emerge victorious?"
{{Frame|Murderer}}
"I can't believe you're betting against {{TS|gold||Noodles!"}}
Furious, he clamps down his helmet and rushes towards his nemesis.
{{Frame|Owner}}
"Give me strength, {{TS|gold||Noodles!"}}
Clamping down his helmet, the knight charges forward.
{{TS|gold|shake|* CRASH!!!* }} {{TS|negative|shake|* KLAAAANG!* }}
{{TS|green|shake|* POW!* }}
'''Depending on who loses the joust:''' The owner died. / The nemesis was slain.

'''When losing the bet:'''
You {{TS|negative||lost}} the bet, but at least you weren't gouged by a lance.
'''When winning the bet:'''
You {{TS|green||win}} the bet. Unsure what to think, you grab your winnings and leave.
==Notes== * If the player possesses {{R|Ectoplasm}}, this event is a mandatory loss of 50 [[Gold]]. There is no option to leave the event without betting, and any potential winnings cannot be gained. * The player may consider using the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Expected_value expected value] (EV) of each option to determine who they want to bet on. ** The EV of betting on the Murderer is a net increase of 20 [[Gold]] (a 70% chance to receive 100 [[Gold]] is an expected 70 [[Gold]], minus the 50 [[Gold]] that was bet. 0.7 x 100 - 50 = 20) ** The EV of betting on the Owner is a net increase of 25 [[Gold]] (a 30% chance to receive 250 [[Gold]] is an expected 75 [[Gold]], minus the 50 [[Gold]] that was bet. 0.3 x 250 - 50 = 25) ** It may be more beneficial to ignore the EV and instead consider whether the relatively safe 50 extra [[Gold]] by betting on the Murderer is more useful to the player's current run compared to risking the bet on the Owner and likely losing their 50 [[Gold]] for the more unlikely net gain of 200 [[Gold]]. ==Update History== * '''Weekly Patch 21: Channel Lightning''' ** Seeds are now utilized for The Joust event. * '''Weekly Patch 2: Slimes!''' ** Joust event now has correct wording for some incorrect options. {{EventNav}} [[Category:Events]]
